cohort: 78 primiparous women with postpartum symptomatic SUI, divided into eCS and sVD groups (matched 1:1)
finding: While eCS was associated with higher PFM strength, it also showed greater PFM hyperactivity, and sVD had a greater impact on bladder neck and urethral hyperactivity.
mod_finding: This study found differences in pelvic floor muscle morphology and function in primiparas with postpartum symptomatic stress urinary incontinence after elective cesarean section compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery.
